baseline: Replace calcBox()/split(startLevel) and depth calculation with tree.build(); all other code and workloads identical.
candidate: Octree depth ceil(log2(triangleCount)/3), at least one level, consumed through the public split starting-level argument.
timing: Fresh process per sample; geometry creation and initial GC excluded from prepareMs. Preparation retains overlay and index. Picking uses 20 warmup rays then 120 measured rays. Samples sorted ascending.
memory: Before and endpoint process.memoryUsage after explicit GC; endpoint retains source geometry, displayed geometry, materials and complete picking index. peakRssKiB is process.resourceUsage().maxRSS including transient construction.
verdict: Manual diagnostic, no CI timing thresholds. Compare median across three fresh processes per workload. Replacing the candidate block with tree.build() reintroduces the measured preparation and memory cost.
behavior: Native-raycaster comparison on indexed curved/flat meshes for front, back and double sides; existing material seam, visibility, hover and disposal tests.

layoutToggle.timing: One prepared 197100-triangle overlay; one warmup toggle, then three measured toggles. Baseline disposes/recreates the overlay; candidate suspends/resumes it. Geometry and shader object identities are retained only in the candidate.
layoutToggle.memory: Initial and endpoint GC with one live overlay; whole-process peak RSS includes initial index construction and all toggles.
